The '''servant''' of [[Belo Tusus]] was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. She served Tusus as he ruled [[Orto/Legends|Orto]] during the late stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but later leaked vital information to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nem Bees]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BeloTusus.jpg|thumb|right|190px|The Twi'lek from the ''Republic'' line that Jewhurst intended to be this character.]]
Initially, [[Kyle Jewhurst]], author of the Belo Tusus [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry, had intended for the servant to be the one featured briefly in [[Republic 79|''Republic'' 79]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|lordhydronium|1|Tales of a Jedi: The Creation of Nem Bees}}</ref>
